baseline:
B
A normal distribution is a symmetric, bell-shaped probability distribution. Its exact shape and location are determined by two parameters: the mean (center) and the variance (spread).

C
The sum of two random variables, X + Y, represents the sum of their individual values. In this case, it is the sum of Luna's nap time and Max's nap time, which is their combined nap time.

B
The sum of two independent normal random variables is also a normal random variable. Its mean is the sum of the individual means (μ₁ + μ₂), and its variance is the sum of the individual variances (σ₁² + σ₂²).

B
The new mean is the sum of the original means, and the new variance is the sum of the original variances. A larger variance results in a wider, more spread-out curve.

B
When adding two independent normal random variables, the means add and the variances add. The mean of the combined error is 0 + 0 = 0. The variance of the combined error is 1 + 2 = 3. Therefore, the combined distribution is N(0, 3).
